coffees.name: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe
coffees.description: Washed heirloom varieties prized for floral aromatics and tea-like clarity.

methods.name: V60 Pour Over
methods.summary: Bright, floral cup with clean separation of notes.

steps.title: Rinse filter
steps.body: Place filter in dripper, rinse with hot water, discard rinse water.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.body: Add grounds, pour 40 g water, swirl gently, wait 30 seconds.

steps.title: Main pour
steps.body: Pour in slow circles to 250 g total over 2 minutes.

steps.title: Drawdown
steps.body: Let drain fully; target brew time 2:30–3:00.

methods.name: French Press
methods.summary: Fuller body while keeping fruit notes.

steps.title: Add coffee
steps.body: Place coarse grounds in preheated press.

steps.title: Pour and steep
steps.body: Pour all water, stir once, place lid, steep 4 minutes.

steps.title: Plunge
steps.body: Press slowly and serve immediately.

coffees.name: Colombian Huila Pitalito
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness and acidity from high-altitude smallholder lots.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body: Rinse filter, add grounds, level bed.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.body: Pour 40 g, wait 35 seconds.

steps.title: Pulse pours
steps.body: Three pours to 260 g, finish by 2:45.

methods.name: Espresso
methods.summary: Chocolate-forward shot with mild apple finish.

steps.title: Dose and tamp
steps.body: Distribute evenly, tamp level with 15 kg pressure.

steps.title: Extract
steps.body: Start shot immediately; aim for honey-like stream.

steps.title: Taste
steps.body: Adjust grind finer if sour, coarser if bitter.

coffees.name: Indian Monsooned Malabar
coffees.description: Monsoon-processed beans with low acidity and heavy body.

methods.name: South Indian Filter
methods.summary: Traditional decoction for strong, syrupy coffee.

steps.title: Load upper chamber
steps.body: Add fine grounds, press gently with stem.

steps.title: Brew decoction
steps.body: Pour boiling water, cover, drip 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Mix decoction with hot milk; add jaggery if desired.

coffees.name: Sumatra Mandheling
coffees.description: Wet-hulled profile with herbal depth and syrupy mouthfeel.

steps.title: Steep
steps.body: Steep 4:30 for maximum body.

steps.title: Plunge
steps.body: Press slowly; decant all coffee to avoid over-extraction.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Fill basket level, do not tamp.

steps.title: Heat
steps.body: Medium-low heat until gurgling begins.

steps.title: Stop
steps.body: Remove from heat when flow turns blonde.

coffees.name: Turkish Blend
coffees.description: Very fine grind brewed in cezve with optional cardamom.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Mix coffee, water, and sugar in cezve off heat.

steps.title: Heat slowly
steps.body: Stir once, heat until foam rises—do not boil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Pour including foam; let grounds settle before sipping.

coffees.name: Kenyan AA Nyeri
coffees.description: SL28/SL34 lots with vibrant black-currant acidity.

methods.name: Chemex
methods.summary: Clean cup that showcases Kenyan acidity.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.body: Pour 60 g, wait 45 seconds.

steps.title: Pour
steps.body: Continuous spiral pour to 500 g by 3:30.

coffees.name: Guatemalan Antigua
coffees.description: Volcanic soil character with chocolate and spice.

steps.title: Invert
steps.body: Add coffee and water, stir 10 seconds.

steps.title: Press
steps.body: Attach filter, flip, press over 30 seconds.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.body: 40 g water, 30 second bloom.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Pour to 250 g by 2:30.

coffees.name: Brazilian Santos
coffees.description: Nutty, low-acid profile ideal for milk drinks.

steps.title: Extract
steps.body: Pull 1:2 ratio shot in 25–30 seconds.

steps.title: Steam milk
steps.body: Texture milk to microfoam for latte art.

coffees.name: Vietnamese Robusta
coffees.description: Robusta-forward blend for phin and iced milk coffee.

methods.name: Phin Filter
methods.summary: Slow drip over ice and sweetened condensed milk.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.body: Add 20 ml water, wait 30 seconds.

steps.title: Drip
steps.body: Fill chamber, cover, drip 4–5 minutes onto ice and milk.

coffees.name: Everyday Instant Coffee
coffees.description: Quick cup when time is short—still worth doing well.

methods.name: Classic Instant
methods.summary: Dissolve in hot water without scorching.

steps.title: Wet grounds
steps.body: Stir instant with a splash of cool water first.

steps.title: Top up
steps.body: Add hot (not boiling) water and stir.

methods.name: Iced Instant
methods.summary: Shake or stir over ice for a refreshing drink.

steps.title: Dissolve
steps.body: Shake instant with cold water until frothy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Pour over ice; add milk if desired.

coffees.name: Panama Geisha
coffees.description: Celebrated auction lot with extraordinary florals and tea-like clarity.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.body: 30 g water, 40 second bloom.

steps.title: Slow pours
steps.body: Two gentle pours to 200 g, finish by 2:45.
